timeperd.current: The data receive daily updates to reflect the most current information available. In aggregate, the data were collected throughout the existence of MPCA’s Remediation Program. Individual records are collected throughout the life-cycle of a Remediation Program interest. Several date fields contained in the data describe when an individual record was last collected or the location information was modified.

descript.abstract: These are areas where the groundwater contamination potentially originated. Not every site included in the Minnesota Groundwater Contamination Atlas has a mapped source area.The Atlas was first published in June 2020. It shows where testing monitoring wells shows groundwater areas of contamination. Areas are then drawn around the wells and lines represent the certainity of that part of the area.
descript.purpose: Source areas can be important parts of the contamination areas to indicate where the chemical contamination started.
